unresolved.what: Ceuta before its 1995 Statute of Autonomy
unresolved.why: Sources disagree on whether Ceuta was part of Cádiz province: separated from Cádiz by RD 20-03-1925, reattached "for legal purposes" by order of 21-01-1932, otherwise a plaza de soberanía with its own military/government delegation. No source settles its first-level membership for each window.
checked: El Faro de Ceuta (A. Guerra Caballero)
unresolved.needs: a primary legal source fixing Ceuta's provincial membership 1900-1995 (no finer atoms needed: the atom is the whole municipality)

unresolved.what: Melilla before its 1995 Statute of Autonomy
unresolved.why: One secondary account says Melilla was a municipality of Málaga province until 1995; the 1943 REVL article says the 1927 Junta Municipal statute recognised no direct dependence on any province. Contradictory; unsettled.
unresolved.needs: a primary legal source on Melilla's provincial membership 1900-1995
